title: Maja Bjeljac — the about page as a family tree
note: Info is drawn as a diagram: a 1px vertical black spine with branches leading to each block. There's a portrait card with role labels, a handwritten 'started with a point-and-shoot…' note (an image), and a lime #C9FE65 KONTAKT box with a 2px black border and a solid blush #FBBCB3 offset shadow (about 6px down and right), with a yellow highlighter behind its label. A yellow #FFF148 circle holds publications, and the exhibitions list is mono year + underlined title. Static, and the tree still works on a phone. Worth reusing: a bio laid out as a diagram, and sticker-like boxes that give an about page personality.
